#!/bin/bash
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base
export HF_HUB_CACHE=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache

echo "Model: lerobot/smolvla_libero"
echo "GPU: cuda:1"
echo "Time: $(date)"

cd /root/acib

for SUITE in libero_spatial libero_object libero_goal libero_10; do
    echo ""
    echo "=== Suite: $SUITE ==="
    echo "Start: $(date)"
    lerobot-eval \
        --policy.path=lerobot/smolvla_libero \
        --env.type=libero \
        --env.task=$SUITE \
        --eval.n_episodes=50 \
        --eval.batch_size=1 \
        --output_dir=/root/acib/outputs/baseline_std/$SUITE \

    echo "End: $(date)"
done

echo ""
echo "=== ALL SUITES DONE ==="
echo "Time: $(date)"
SHEOF

cat > /tmp/watch_and_launch_eval.sh << 'SHEOF'
#!/bin/bash
BLOB_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache/models--lerobot--smolvla_libero/blobs"
INCOMPLETE="${BLOB_DIR}/9a9f6413e42c0f332fccbce9a0dc796af2790f82cf002f791cdbf7e01e1afca8.incomplete"
FINAL="${BLOB_DIR}/9a9f6413e42c0f332fccbce9a0dc796af2790f82cf002f791cdbf7e01e1afca8"
SNAP_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache/models--lerobot--smolvla_libero/snapshots/31d453f7edd78c839a8bbc39744a292686daf0de"

# Wait for wget to finish (incomplete file disappears or reaches target size)
TARGET_SIZE=906712520
while true; do
    if [ ! -f "$INCOMPLETE" ] && [ -f "$FINAL" ]; then
        echo "$(date): Download already complete (final blob exists)"
        break
    fi
    if [ -f "$INCOMPLETE" ]; then
        CURRENT=$(stat -c%s "$INCOMPLETE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
        echo "$(date): model.safetensors download: ${CURRENT}/${TARGET_SIZE} bytes ($(( CURRENT * 100 / TARGET_SIZE ))%)"
        if [ "$CURRENT" -ge "$TARGET_SIZE" ]; then
            echo "$(date): Download complete, renaming..."
            mv "$INCOMPLETE" "$FINAL"
            break
        fi
    fi
    # Also check if wget PID is still alive
    if ! pgrep -f "wget.*model.safetensors" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        if [ -f "$INCOMPLETE" ]; then
            CURRENT=$(stat -c%s "$INCOMPLETE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
            if [ "$CURRENT" -ge "$TARGET_SIZE" ]; then
                echo "$(date): wget done, file complete, renaming..."
                mv "$INCOMPLETE" "$FINAL"
                break
            else
                echo "$(date): ERROR: wget died but file incomplete (${CURRENT}/${TARGET_SIZE})"
                exit 1
            fi
        fi
    fi
    sleep 10
done

# Create symlink for model.safetensors in snapshot
if [ ! -L "${SNAP_DIR}/model.safetensors" ]; then
    ln -s "../../blobs/9a9f6413e42c0f332fccbce9a0dc796af2790f82cf002f791cdbf7e01e1afca8" "${SNAP_DIR}/model.safetensors"
    echo "$(date): Created model.safetensors symlink"
fi

# Verify
ls -la "${SNAP_DIR}/model.safetensors"
echo "$(date): Model ready. Launching eval..."

mkdir -p /root/acib/outputs/baseline_std
bash /root/acib/scripts/run_eval_std.sh > /root/acib/outputs/baseline_std/main.log 2>&1
echo "$(date): Eval finished."
SHEOF
chmod +x /tmp/watch_and_launch_eval.sh
nohup bash /tmp/watch_and_launch_eval.sh > /tmp/watch_eval.log 2>&1 & echo "WATCHER_PID=$!"
